remarks: Open house-Sunday, October 11th from 11 am to 1 pm.  Beautifully maintained & thoughtfully updated by the same owner for 36 years, this charming home began as a Cape Cod & has evolved into a spacious Colonial-style layout through well-planned additions that expanded the kitchen & enhanced the 2nd floor. Pride of ownership is evident throughout! Major improvements include a new roof, furnace & central air approximately 2 years ago, updated electric, copper plumbing, maintenance-free vinyl siding & railings, Trex decking & more. The spacious eat-in kitchen features oak cabinetry, a breakfast bar & plenty of room for everyday dining, with gas stove, refrigerator & dishwasher included. First floor bedroom with its bay window offers plenty of natural light.  The inviting living room offers newer carpeting with hardwood flooring beneath the carpet. Upstairs, the generous primary bedroom features a large walk-in closet. An additional 16'4" x 14'8" walk-through room offers wonderful flexibility as a potential 4th bedroom, sitting room, home office, hobby space or additional living area. The partially finished basement provides even more usable space with a recreation area, plus the washer, dryer, refrigerator & sleeper sofa are included. Outside, enjoy a vinyl privacy-fenced yard, Trex decking & maintenance-free shed for additional storage. Rear-yard drain tile with bubbler adds another thoughtful improvement. Verizon Fios available. An exceptionally well-cared-for home with decades of improvements already completed—ready for its next owner to enjoy!
